content:
We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to target molecule C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2 reproduces Peterson reaction: forward: beta-hydroxy silane -> alkene, breaking C-Si and C-O, forming C=C. In retrosynthesis, we need to break C=C into C-O and C-Si (i.e., generate a beta-hydroxy silane precursor). So functional groups broken in forward: carbon-silicon bond, carbon-oxygen bond (alcohol). Formed: carbon-carbon double bond (alkene). So for retrosynthetic template, we need functional_groups_broken = ['trimethylsilyl','alcohol']? Actually forward breaks Si-C and C-O (alcohol). Formed: alkene. So search criteria: functional_groups_broken: maybe ['trimethylsilyl','alcohol']; functional_groups_formed: ['alkene']; also bonds broken: Si-C, C-O; bonds formed: C=C.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with those.
